spec_match.rationale: Issues a real navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia call with the exact audioSelection dictionary member from the mediacapture-screen-share spec.

interactive.rationale: Controls trigger the real capture call and reflect live state; stop/reset restore the initial state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card copy matches the page's delivered behavior.

edge_cases.rationale: The picker-pending and dismissal paths are honest, but denied-permission and no-audio-track outcomes could be surfaced more distinctly.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus entry and spec anchors linked from the feature index and page.

conformance.rationale: The root suite rendered 8 pass / 0 fail / 0 blocked in this browser and its assertions target the audioSelection surface.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless-Chrome CDP run 2026-08-16: real getDisplayMedia invoked (picker pending in headless — the honest state, no fake success), zero console errors, zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry asserts present for the call/fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: Shared variables and AA pairs; buttons override background and colour together.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, aria-live output for async results, visible focus.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric's accessibility and runtime_evidence scores applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's primary controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Capture button issued the real audioSelection:'preferred' call; the readout honestly reported the pending system picker (headless cannot approve it) instead of faking a stream. Stop control present and disabled until a stream exists.
